note: KL2d: a Sigma analytic 'cannot match' when its positive clauses reference a column none of its declared families fills. `cause` separates the two reasons: `corpus_absent` means the families that DO fill the column are not staged in the representative corpus, so the rule is correct but unmeasurable here (the WO allows this, recorded); `no_lane_has_it` means no declared lane has that column at all, which is the defect to drop. Production code is unchanged by this measurement.
